flags.usage: Remove the plist despite an unavailable launchd domain (may leave a daemon running)

flags.name: json
flags.usage: Output as JSON

detail.description: macOS only. TSLink-authored explanation kept separate from launchctl_output; present for already_absent and unconfirmed domain-state remedies.

force_available.description: macOS failure only. True when an explicit --force recovery path exists for launchctl_domain_unavailable.

force_command.description: macOS failure only. Exact command that invokes the explicit --force recovery path.

force_risk.description: macOS failure only. Residual daemon risk accepted by running force_command.

launchctl_outcome.description: macOS only. Discriminates no installed plist, a confirmed bootout, confirmed absence from every domain, and an unconfirmed domain state. Unconfirmed may be returned with removed=true only after explicit --force.

launchctl_output.description: macOS only. Verbatim trimmed launchctl output from the successful target for unloaded, or combined attempted output for already_absent and unconfirmed; omitted when launchctl emitted no text.

launchctl_target.description: macOS only. The domain target that confirmed bootout or remained unavailable for the reported unconfirmed state; empty for not_installed and already_absent.

path.description: Linux and Windows only. Path to the platform startup artifact inspected or removed by this invocation.

plist_path.description: macOS only. Path to the LaunchAgent plist inspected or removed by this invocation.

removed.description: Whether the platform startup artifact was removed by this invocation.

service_manager.description: Linux and Windows only. Platform startup mechanism responsible for the artifact.

unavailable_domain.description: macOS failure only. The unavailable launchd domain, such as gui/501, when error.code is launchctl_domain_unavailable.

warning.description: Actionable non-fatal warning on a successful forced removal; omitted on failures and when no warning applies.

allow_unsupported_for_tcp.description: HTTP allow lists do not apply to raw TCP

api_forbidden.description: Tailscale refused the API credential (HTTP 403): its user role or OAuth scopes do not permit the operation

api_token_unauthorized.description: Tailscale rejected the stored API credential as unauthenticated (HTTP 401) during ACL, device, auth-key derivation, or login verification; next carries the key-bootstrap steps

config_load_failed.description: config.json exists but cannot be read strictly (malformed JSON or an unknown key); commands that would persist its settings refuse to guess

conflict.description: requested state conflicts with existing state

credential_control_url_mismatch.description: a credentialed daemon refuses to send an auth key minted through the Tailscale API to a control server that is not Tailscale's; the service is not started

funnel_allow_conflict.description: Funnel conflicts with an allow list

funnel_capability_missing.description: service tsnet node lacks Funnel capability, HTTPS, or allowed port

funnel_expiry_required.description: a Funnel entry records neither a funnel_expires_at deadline nor "never"; it is not made public until one is set

funnel_listen_failed.description: Funnel capability preflight passed but listener activation failed

invalid_service_name.description: service name is not a valid DNS label

invite_api_forbidden.description: Tailscale rejected the user-owned token's user permissions with HTTP 403; HTTP 401 (expired, revoked, or invalid token) is reported as invite_api_unauthorized

invite_api_key_required.description: a user-owned tskey-api- token is required and OAuth is not eligible

invite_api_unauthorized.description: Tailscale rejected the user-owned tskey-api- token as unauthenticated (HTTP 401): expired, revoked, or invalid; next carries the key-bootstrap steps

invite_device_ambiguous.description: multiple hostname candidates remain after ownership resolution

invite_device_ownership_unproven.description: TSLink lacks exact stable nodeId proof for the device

invite_id_invalid.description: invite ID is not a bare ASCII decimal string

invite_kind_invalid.description: invite namespace is not explicitly user or device

invite_not_found.description: invite or matching service device was not found

invite_rate_limited.description: Tailscale rate limited the invite operation

invite_request_invalid.description: Tailscale rejected the invite request as another 4xx input error

invite_resend_email_missing.description: an invite created without email cannot be resent

invite_response_invalid.description: Tailscale returned an invalid invite wire response

invite_role_invalid.description: invite role is outside the first-party enum

invite_state_conflict.description: Tailscale rejected the invite operation because current remote state conflicts with it (HTTP 409)

launchctl_domain_unavailable.description: a launchd domain could not be checked; failure data names the domain, explicit --force command, and residual risk

legacy_config_dir_present.description: Windows only: the config directory is still at the legacy %USERPROFILE%\.config\tslink location; TSLink never moves it, and next carries the one manual move command

login_verify_failed.description: login could not verify the candidate credential against Tailscale for a reason other than HTTP 401/403; the previous credential was kept

path_exposes_config_dir.description: file service path is, contains, or lies inside TSLink's config directory, which holds node keys and credentials

path_must_be_absolute.description: file service path must be absolute

path_not_accessible.description: file service path is not accessible to the current user

path_not_directory.description: file service path is not a directory

path_not_found.description: file service directory does not exist

service_start_timeout.description: service node did not reach running state before its startup deadline

service_type_ambiguous.description: exactly one service type is required

url_not_ready.description: runtime has not reported an exact tailnet hostname
